name: Modern 3D Asset Forge
actions: inspect the pinned 3D build capabilities and named gaps
run one explicit source asset through bounded native delivery stages
verify GLB structure, Khronos conformance, KTX2 binding and WebGL2 loading separately
export a manifest and receipts only after explicit review
summary: A parallel modern 3D delivery module with measured capability gates, source/delivery separation, native tool stages, deterministic KTX2-in-GLB binding, matching local compressed-browser decoders, and live smoke receipts.
notes: Phase 0 and Phase 1 only. The module never installs tools, downloads libraries, crawls source sites, or treats diagnostic fallbacks as canonical delivery evidence.
